name: work-atlas
description: A live dashboard of the session beside the chat: what Claude is doing, what it cost, where the time went, which files it touched and what failed

coreName.title: Centre label
coreName.description: Text shown in the middle of the activity map. Maximum 10 characters.

memoryServers.title: Memory MCP servers
memoryServers.description: Names of MCP servers that provide memory. Calls to their tools are counted as Memory instead of Network or Tools.

cellShape.title: Row height ÷ column width
cellShape.description: Ratio of the pane's text row height to its column width, between 1.2 and 4. Used to size the drawing to the pane's height. Increase it if there is a gap under the drawing; decrease it if the pane scrolls.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Starting theme: nebula (navy and cyan, with glow), dark (neutral greys) or light (paper and ink). You can switch any time from the theme menu in the pane.

alerts.title: Usage alerts
alerts.description: Show a one-time notice when the context window is over 85% full, and another when a usage limit is over 90%.
